cameras.name: Cam 1 - Lobby
cameras._deterrence_comment: Probed 2026-10-20: camera is a Xiongmai IPC_GK7205V500_G5SF (no ISAPI, NO speaker/audio-out). It DOES expose an ONVIF relay output RELAY_OUTPUT_000 (monostable, 10s auto-reset) on port 8899. Driver 'onvif' pulses that relay -> wire an EXTERNAL strobe + siren to the camera's alarm-out terminals. No built-in strobe/speaker on this SKU. See deterrence.py / scripts/probe_camera.py.

_topology_comment: Single live camera — no cross-camera topology yet. Add edges here when more live cameras are connected.
